components.purpose: The core of the request: a feature-by-feature comparison of our product against two competitors, with features as rows and a column for each product. Its guidance says it is for comparing us with competitors, so it is the only component on this instance that fits.
Optional closing call to action after the comparison, so readers have a next step (for example, a trial or demo). It is a bottom-placed component, which fits the end of the page.
